### Goal
Fix dunning emails to paid customers, resume per-resource router extraction, then complete production webhook v1→v2 cutover.

### Constraints and rules
Execute cutover steps sequentially, stopping on failure. Never edit `config/ledgerly.toml` without posting its diff in `#billing-config` for `@maya`. Never modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting its diff in `#privacy-review` and obtaining `@mina` approval. Router extraction remains paused. Do not increase Celery visibility timeout.

### Key decisions and facts
Webhook retries belong in `WebhookSender`: retry transport/retryable server failures; propagate 4xx immediately. `max_attempts`: default 3, minimum 1, bounded backoff. Current staging exports bucket is `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; old bucket is frozen and must not be written. Webhook v2 health passed; production image update to `v2.8.1` succeeded.

### Ruled out
Retrying all `HTTPStatusError`; six-hour visibility timeout for duplicate runs.

### Progress
CSV exporter now explicitly writes UTF-8; UTF-8 regression added. Full suite: 186 passed, 3 skipped; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Invoice typing began by importing `Decimal`, `Iterable`, and `TypedDict`; `LineItem` annotation added.

### Next steps
Finish and test invoice annotations. Then fix/test `dunning/scheduler.py` to exclude paid invoices, resume router extraction, and execute/verify cutover steps 4–8 sequentially.

### Goal
Split monolithic `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers. Separately run the ordered production “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” procedure.

### Constraints and rules
Run cutover steps one at a time in the given order. Never edit `config/ledgerly.toml` without posting its diff in `#billing-config` for `@maya`. Never modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving `@mina` approval.

### Key decisions and facts
Webhook retries belong in `WebhookSender`: retry transport errors and retryable server responses, but immediately propagate 4xx errors. `max_attempts` defaults to 3 and must be ≥1; backoff is bounded. Full suite: 44 passed. Search baseline: 18 passed, 2 failed due to recently updated invoice descriptions missing from rebuilt documents. Staging exports bucket: `ledgerly-exports-stg`.

### Ruled out
Retrying all `HTTPStatusError` exceptions; existing behavior proves 4xx responses are non-retryable.

### Progress
Webhook implementation/tests complete: 8 webhook tests pass; Ruff and diff checks pass. Router split and production cutover have not started.

### Next steps
Implement router extraction. Then execute and verify all eight cutover commands sequentially, pausing on failure. Investigate search-index failures if in scope.
